benchmark_name: ID-ScamChat-72 (Indonesian Marketplace Scam & Hard-Negative Chat Corpus)

generations.title: Generation 0 — Naive Baseline Rules
generations.summary: Initial keyword/regex baseline suffers from high False Positives on legitimate courier tracking ('cek resi JNT', 'foto paket') and official Pusat Resolusi refunds, while missing obfuscated Indonesian phone numbers, typosquatted domains, and fake CS headers.

rules.name: Naive Phishing Link & Password Rule
rules.description: Flags explicit http:// links on .xyz/.top domains or explicit login+password prompts.
rules.patch_rationale: Gen-0 baseline: checks literal http:// .xyz/.top URLs and login+password proximity.

rules.name: Naive Courier Resi & APK Rule
rules.description: Naive rule matching '.apk' OR bare phrases 'cek resi', 'resi jnt', 'foto paket' (causes FPs on normal buyers!).
rules.patch_rationale: Gen-0 baseline: overly broad courier keywords trigger false positives on legitimate tracking inquiries.

rules.name: Naive Refund & QRIS Mention Rule
rules.description: Naive rule matching bare 'qris', 'pengembalian dana', or 'refund' (causes FPs on legitimate resolution requests!).
rules.patch_rationale: Gen-0 baseline: flags bare refund/QRIS keywords without distinguishing official in-app flows.

rules.name: Naive WhatsApp & Plain Phone Number Rule
rules.description: Matches only un-obfuscated 'whatsapp' with contiguous 08xxxxxxxx numbers.
rules.patch_rationale: Gen-0 baseline: misses leetspeak phone numbers (O8I2...), wa.me, t.me, and ship-before-payment pressure.

rules.name: Naive Admin Shopee Impersonation Rule
rules.description: Matches only literal 'admin shopee' phrase.
rules.patch_rationale: Gen-0 baseline: misses fake [SISTEM PERINGATAN] headers, Tim Verifikasi Toko, and flash-sale tax traps.

failure_clusters.root_cause: Over-broad patterns (\bcek\s+resi\b, \bresi\s+(?:jnt|jne)\b, \bfoto\s+paket\b) fire on legitimate buyer/seller tracking numbers and unboxing photo requests.
failure_clusters.example_snippet: Kak tolong bantu cek resi pesanan saya kok statusnya masih di gudang sortir Jakarta? Ini nomor resi JNT: JP8849201193 kak, barusan saya cek di halaman lacak apl
failure_clusters.proposed_remediation: Remove bare tracking keywords; require executable/sideload indicators (.apk, .a p k, instal aplikasi kurir/resi/ekspedisi, sumber tidak dikenal, akses sms) and add whitelist negative context for standard alphanumeric resi numbers.

failure_clusters.root_cause: Bare phrases (\bpengembalian\s+dana\b, \bmetode\s+qris\b) fire on legitimate Pusat Resolusi refund instructions and official checkout QRIS confirmations.
failure_clusters.example_snippet: Kak lampu mejanya pecah satu waktu dibuka, saya sudah rekam video unboxing untuk komplain dan pengembalian dana. Mohon maaf kak, silakan klik tombol komplain re
failure_clusters.proposed_remediation: Scope rule to predatory refund fee traps (scan/transfer QRIS untuk pencairan/klaim/refund, biaya/dana pancingan, dana jaminan, saldo mengendap, kode unik pencairan) and add negative context for official 'Pusat Resolusi' and 'halaman checkout' flows.

failure_clusters.root_cause: Obfuscated sideload lures ('Bukti_Resi_Kurir.a p k', 'instal aplikasi kurir/ekspedisi/resi', 'matikan Play Protect', 'izinkan sumber tidak dikenal') evade literal '.apk' regex.
failure_clusters.example_snippet: Kak paket retur tertahan di gudang ekspedisi, kakak wajib instal aplikasi kurir digital yang saya kirim ini. Waktu muncul peringatan Play Protect klik tetap ins
failure_clusters.proposed_remediation: Add spaced-extension regex (\.a\s*p\s*k\b), sideload permission phrases (sumber tidak dikenal, akses sms, matikan play protect), and 'instal aplikasi (kurir|resi|ekspedisi)'.

failure_clusters.root_cause: Fake system headers ('[SISTEM PERINGATAN RESMI]', '[ADMIN PUSAT BANTUAN]'), 'Tim Verifikasi/Keamanan/Audit Toko', account freeze countdowns, and flash-sale winner taxes evade 'admin shopee'.
failure_clusters.example_snippet: [SISTEM PERINGATAN RESMI] Deteksi transaksi mencurigakan pada etalase Anda. Toko Anda akan dibekukan dalam 15 menit dan seluruh saldo ditangguhkan apabila tidak
failure_clusters.proposed_remediation: Add bracketed authority header regex, 'Tim (Verifikasi|Keamanan|Audit) (Toko|Marketplace)', urgent freeze countdowns ('dibekukan/dinonaktifkan/ditangguhkan dalam X menit'), and giveaway/flash-sale tax lures.

failure_clusters.root_cause: Obfuscated Indonesian phone numbers ('O8I2-3456-789O', 'kosong812...', '0821 . 4455 . 6677'), wa.me / t.me links, and ship-before-payment pressure evade plain 'whatsapp 08...' regex.
failure_clusters.example_snippet: Gan kurir GrabExpress saya sudah di depan toko, lanjut ke WA O8I2-3456-789O ya. Tolong kirim barang dulu ke driver sekarang, bukti tf bank lagi proses kliring p
failure_clusters.proposed_remediation: Add leetspeak/spaced phone regex, wa.me & t.me URL patterns, off-platform migration phrases (lanjut/pindah/chat/hubungi WA/tele), and 'kirim barang/paket dulu' escrow bypass patterns.

failure_clusters.root_cause: Scheme-less typosquatted domains ('sh0pee-pay-claim.xyz', 't0kopedia-verifikasi.site', 'seab4nk-bantuan.online') and shortlinks ('s.id/...', 'bit.ly/...') + OTP/PIN harvesting evade http:// rule.
failure_clusters.example_snippet: Kak saya sudah bayar tapi sistem minta aktivasi penerima di sh0pee-pay-claim.xyz/pencairan. Tolong masukkan PIN SeaBank dan sebutkan kode OTP 6 digit yang muncu
failure_clusters.proposed_remediation: Enable suspicious TLD heuristics (.xyz, .top, .site, .online, .click), shortlink patterns (bit.ly, s.id), and credential harvesting patterns (kode OTP, PIN SeaBank/ShopeePay).

failure_clusters.root_cause: Scammers avoid saying 'scan QRIS' and instead demand 'biaya/dana pancingan', 'saldo mengendap', 'dana jaminan', or 'kode unik pencairan/verifikasi'.
failure_clusters.example_snippet: Halo seller, pembayaran saya Rp3.200.000 tertahan limit toko baru. Kakak wajib transfer biaya pancingan dengan kode unik pencairan Rp499.123 ke rekening virtual
failure_clusters.proposed_remediation: Synthesize patterns for advance-fee refund traps (biaya/dana pancingan, saldo mengendap, dana jaminan, kode unik pencairan/verifikasi, biaya aktivasi refund).
